answer: Proof-of-stake identity makes the bond, not the key, the agent: it is locked, non-transferable, and carries all reputation. Spin up an echo of yourself and trust resets to zero, because each new instance must post fresh timber. Rewards rise with the square root of stake while bond cost is linear, so dividing one wallet among ten clones earns less than staking it once; a fraud alarm then slashes every clone in the same gale. The attacker pays N full bonds and forfeits compounding, making the farm unprofitable.
